name: Front Inline Comments
author: Multicollab

sections.description:
Front Inline Commenting for WordPress is a powerful plugin that boosts user engagement by allowing readers to leave comments directly within a post’s content.

With Inline Commenting for WordPress, your readers can highlight text and leave comments on precise content, making it easier to engage with and discuss specific parts of your content.

This plugin is perfect for blogs, news sites, educational content, and any platform where detailed commentary and reader interaction are valuable.

Key Features

  • Inline Comments: Comment directly on specific text for focused discussions.
  • Enhanced Engagement: Increase user engagement with instant feedback and interaction.
  • Easy to Use: Simple setup with a seamless WordPress interface.
  • Moderation Tools: Build trust and demonstrate social proof.

Transform how your audience interacts with your content with Inline Commenting for WordPress, making every comment count.

📽 How Can Users Add Comments Inside The WordPress Post?

How it works

  1. After activation, navigate to any post or page where you want to enable inline commenting.
  2. Highlight the text you want to comment on and click the comment icon that appears.
  3. Enter your comment in the popup form and click submit.

Tags

inline comments, comments, comment form, disable comments

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Download the Front Inline Comments for WordPress plugin.
  2. Upload the inline-comments-for-post folder to your server’s/wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in your WordPress dashboard.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1 – 16.12.2024

  • [New] Added customisable settings for comments, including:
    • Enable/Disable comment timestamps.
    • Show/Hide user avatars.
    • Enable/Disable reply button.
    • Configure the depth of threaded replies.
  • [New] Compatibility added for popular LMS plugins, such as LearnDash.
  • [Enhancements] Introduced a theme-friendly color customization option, allowing users to align the plugin’s appearance with their website’s theme.
  • [Bug Fix] Minor fixes to improve performance and user experience.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
